4. Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that from bare perusal of F.I.R., it is apparent that due to admitted land dispute between one Shawant Sanjay Raj and informant for which informant has already lodged on other case in SC / ST P S Case No. 50 of 2022 of District Gaya against the said Shawant Sanjay Raj , this false and baseless case has been lodged.

entities.text: SC / ST P S Case No. 50 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Shawant Sanjay Raj is the son of this appellant.
There is general and omnibus allegation against this appellant.

Specific accusation of abuse by caste name and assault is against other co-accused persons and as such no case under SC /
ST Act is made out against this appellant.
Appellant claims clean antecedent.
5 . Learned counsel for the respondent No. 2 as well Patna High Court CR.
as learned special Public Prosecutor for the State opposed the bail appeal.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts, this appeal is allowed and the impugned order is set aside.

Let the appellant, named above, in the event of arrest/surrender within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt/production of a copy of this order, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.
10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned special Judge sc /st spl. Court Gaya in connection with SC /ST Police Station Case No. 27 of 2023 .

ST Act is made out against this appellant.

Shawant Sanjay Raj is the son of this appellant.
